stem:
The table shows the linear relationship between the balance of a student’s savings account and the number of weeks he has been saving.

Savings Account

Week | 0 | 1 | 3 | 6 | 8 | 13
Balance (dollars) | 32 | 39 | 53 | 74 | 88 | 123

Based on the table, what was the rate of change of the balance of the student’s savings account in dollars and cents per week?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document.
